title: situation.texas_evacuation_terms.title

gate.none: Military theatre departure of the existing contingent under sourced terms only. No prisoner-treatment, exchange, civilian, slavery or security policy is offered or derived; no benefit for such conduct.

citations.at: pp.502-504,514: February 18 agreement yields posts, retains arms for departure by coast; pp.523-524: February 20 embarkation return; p.552: two transports already sailed by April 17; pp.561-564: Sibley surrendered two First, three Third and two Eighth Infantry companies at Saluria April 25, after Indianola transport failed; pp.567-569,572: Reeve six Eighth companies surrendered May 9, last column. [I] Starting regiment bundles combine different departures/captures. Conservative theatre completion only on the last sourced date: no claim all surrendered together, no invented captive count, destination, exchange or new unit.

namedOnly: The notice identifies an institutional evacuation agreement, not a living speaker or attributed personal words.
